newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RGC mineral sands output maintained.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RGC mineral sands output maintained.

text.p: RGC Ltd said its finished mineral sands goods production rates in the half year ended December 31 were maintained at the record levels of the 1995/96 year despite declining grades at Eneabba in Western Australia and increasing mining and processing challenges at all sites.
RGC detailed its latest quarterly and half-year production figures for the periods ended December 31 as follows. (Figures in tonnes unless otherwise stated.)
